news.title: Michigan elections: School districts seeking nearly $4 billion in bonds
news.summary_en: School districts are asking voters to borrow money for infrastructure projects. Leaders say they know families are facing increased household costs, but their options are limited.
news.author: Isabel Lohman

news.title: Michigan wants to scrap rarely used special ed rule. Child advocates fear harm
news.summary_en: The state Department of Education can mandate that students with disabilities ‘stay put’ in their school settings while it investigates special ed complaints. A plan to remove that provision has sparked an outcry.
news.author: Isabel Lohman

news.title: MSU trustee sues, says ethics policy is unconstitutional
news.summary_en: Michigan State University Trustee Mike Balow has filed a federal lawsuit aimed at modifying an updated ethics policy that includes a “loyalty” clause and more.
news.author: Kim Kozlowski

news.title: Michigan’s free community college shuts out rural universities. They want in
news.summary_en: Four rural-based universities that offer associate degrees are lobbying for expansion of the Community College Guarantee, the state’s free tuition program. Some say it would be costly. Proponents say it would serve all students, especially those in community college “deserts.”
news.author: Kim Kozlowski
